analysis.title: Interactive Brokers Group (IBKR): Monthly: Higher trading activity, but lower account adds and commissions per trade
key_insights: IBKR October metrics were mixed. Margin balances rose about $1.6bn MoM to $106.8bn despite the S&P 500 falling 1% in October, and cleared DARTs rose 5% MoM to 3.6mn.
Commissions per trade (CPT) fell 9 cents MoM after a 6 cent decline in September, driven by 10%/3%/2% lower futures/stock/options CPT.
IBKR added 101k net new accounts in October (-2% YoY, 16% below the 12-month average). Annualized account growth was 22% versus 26% in September, within management's 20-25% long-term guidance.
Total accounts of 5,677.6K were up 34% YoY, above management's 20-25% long-term account growth guidance.
Client assets fell: client equity dropped about $36bn MoM (-4%) to $929bn (+19% YoY), and client cash fell about $5.7bn (-3%) to $180.5bn (+15% YoY).
Commissions per day were $9.0mn, -10% YoY, roughly flat MoM and 7% below the prior 12-month average. Higher DARTs were offset by lower CPT.
Annualized trades per account were 163x, +3% MoM and -29% YoY.
F&O share of cleared DARTs rose about 10bps MoM to 39%, about 30bps above the prior 12-month average. Futures/stock/options DARTs rose 7%/5%/5% MoM.
App downloads of about 195-196k in October were 7% lower MoM and 25% lower YoY, 42% above the 2024 average and in line with the 2025 average. The US was 16% of downloads, followed by Singapore at 5%.
October monthly active users fell 4% YoY, with a YTD monthly average of about 1.7mn versus about 1.4mn for 2025. About 21% of MAUs are in the US, followed by Canada at 7%.
GS cut 2027E net interest income (NII) by 1% for weaker balance sheet expansion, and cut 2026E/27E/28E commission revenue by 1%/5%/4% for lower CPT.
GS EPS estimates fall 1%/2%/1% for 2026E/27E/28E. The Q5-Q8 target P/E drops 2.0x to 29.0x, and the 12-month price target falls about 7% to $103 from $111. The rating stays Buy.
GS remains constructive on IBKR's account growth, which it expects to drive both DARTs and balance sheet expansion.

market_movers.rationale: Price target cut to $103 from $111 on a lower target P/E (29.0x from 31.0x) reflecting lower market multiples, and on lower commission revenue estimates from weaker CPT. Implies about 34% upside to $76.90.

earnings_insights: GS 4Q26E EPS $0.70 (was $0.72). 2026E EPS $2.66 (was $2.68), 2027E $3.09 (was $3.16), 2028E $3.66 (was $3.70). All are GS estimates, not reported figures.
GS revenue estimates: 2026E $7,337.5mn (was $7,384.5mn), 2027E $8,581.0mn (was $8,749.6mn), 2028E $9,848.4mn (was $9,960.0mn). All are GS forecasts.
October monthly operating metrics (reported by the company): cleared DARTs 3,640K, commissions/day $9.0mn, CPT $2.46, net new accounts 101.2K.
risk_factors: Faster interest rate cuts than expected
Margin compression required to sustain account growth
vol_and_positioning: Customer margin balances of $106.8bn were up 31% YoY and about 13% above the prior 12-month average. They rose 1.5% MoM in a month when the S&P 500 fell 1%.
Futures and options were 39% of cleared DARTs, about 30bps above the prior 12-month average.
